unit: neurons per 1,000,000 tokens (in: prompt tokens, out: completion tokens, reasoning included)
note: Responses carry no neuron or cost field, so run.py computes each call's neurons from its usage and these rates: prompt tokens x in / 1e6 + output tokens x out / 1e6, cached prompt tokens counted as uncached. A model missing here is refused; add a row only after reading the pricing page again, and change 'read'. reasoning_efforts lists the efforts the model's page names (null: no reasoning setting, so only --reasoning none or omit).
